picks.what: The Wear and the iron bridge, steel engraving in Meyer’s Universum, vol. 13
picks.why: “Sunderland, the coal town”: river Wear with ships and coal staithes under the Wearmouth Bridge; caption and margins cut

notes: #2 is the same plate photographed in the open book. #1 (Wearmouth Bridge under construction, 1796) skipped: small (976 px), a construction event, crossed by the page fold, and 1848 already covers from 1748. #9 (1852) is a rough sketch of an emigrant ship. P6: only a marina, Penshaw Hill countryside and Sunderland Point (Lancashire). #10–#14 are by photographer Clyde Sunderland (San Francisco).
